async def act(page):
    # Check the current value of the project name textbox
    title_field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name')
    current_title = await title_field.input_value()
    if current_title == 'Welcome to my site':
        # Title is already set, no action needed
        return
    # Clear the existing value and set the new title
    await title_field.fill('')
    await title_field.fill('Welcome to my site')
    # Click the 'Save changes' button, using .first to avoid strict mode violation
    save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save changes').first
    await save_button.click()
    # Wait for the save operation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
